verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Titan Security Keys' form factors, transports (USB/NFC/Bluetooth), CTAP1/U2F compatibility, and account enrollment/removal flows, but never mentions a FIDO2 PIN, fingerprint/biometric sensor, or any on-device user-verification mechanism. Since Titan keys are documented only via password/possession-based sign-in flows (docs-2, docs-14) with no UV capability referenced, there's no support for this axis in the evidence.
